summary: Frontend-only verification of footer polish (stroke, column spacing, bottom-bar hairline) at 1920/1440/1280/390. All targeted acceptance criteria pass: footer has rounded-top-42px corners with visible light-cyan stroke, three link columns are tightly grouped (gap-x-10 = 40px), bottom-bar hairline is visible with rgba(255,255,255,0.2), headings are blue rgb(77,155,255), no horizontal overflow, and email row never overlaps the columns.
